context_title:
ez mi? (ns autonomousresearchagent.server
  "Productionready autonomous research agent backend.
   Architecture: Exa search, Claude Sonnet 4.5 (Bedrock), Grok 4 Fast, Cerebras GPTOSS120B, Dragonfly cache.
   No mocks, no placeholders. Full SigV4 signing for Bedrock."
  (:genclass)
  (:require
    [ring.adapter.jetty :refer [runjetty]]
    [ring.middleware.params :refer [wrapparams]]
    [ring.middleware.json :refer [wrapjsonbody wrapjsonresponse]]
    [ring.middleware.cors :refer [wrapcors]]
    [ring.util.response :as resp]
    [compojure.core :refer [defroutes GET POST]]
    [compojure.route :as route]
    [cheshire.core :as json]
    [cljhttp.client :as http]
    [taoensso.carmine :as car]
    [clojure.string :as str]
    [clojure.java.io :as io]
    [clojure.tools.logging :as log])
  (:import
    [java.time Instant ZoneId]
    [java.time.format DateTimeFormatter]
    [java.security MessageDigest]
    [javax.crypto Mac]
    [javax.crypto.spec SecretKeySpec]
    [java.nio.charset StandardCharsets]
    [java.util Base64]))

;; ============================================================================
;; CONFIGURATION (environment variables)
;; ============================================================================

(def ^:private config
  {:port              (Integer/parseInt (or (System/getenv "PORT") "8080"))
   :exaapikey       (System/getenv "EXA_API_KEY")
   :awsaccesskey    (System/getenv "AWS_ACCESS_KEY_ID")
   :awssecretkey    (System/getenv "AWS_SECRET_ACCESS_KEY")
   :awsregion        (or (System/getenv "AWS_REGION") "useast1")
   :xaiapikey       (System/getenv "XAI_API_KEY")         ;; xAI direct or OpenRouter key
   :cerebrasapikey  (System/getenv "CEREBRAS_API_KEY")
   :dragonflyuri     (or (System/getenv "DRAGONFLY_URI") "redis://127.0.0.1:6379")})

(defn validateconfig! []
  (doseq [[k v] config]
    (when (and ({:exaapikey :awsaccesskey :awssecretkey :xaiapikey :cerebrasapikey} k)
               (str/blank? v))
      (throw (exinfo (str "Missing environment variable for " (name k)) {:key k}))))
  (log/info "Configuration validated."))

;; ============================================================================
;; DRAGONFLY (Redis) CLIENT
;; ============================================================================

(def ^:private redisconn {:pool {} :spec (car/urispec (:dragonflyuri config))})

(defmacro wcar [& body]
  (car/wcar redisconn ~@body))

(defn cacheget [k]
  (wcar (car/get k)))

(defn cachesetex [k ttl v]
  (wcar (car/setex k ttl v)))

(defn cachehgetall [k]
  (wcar (car/hgetall k)))

(defn cachehset [k field val]
  (wcar (car/hset k field val)))

(defn cachesadd [k & members]
  (wcar (apply car/sadd k members)))

(defn cachesmembers [k]
  (wcar (car/smembers k)))

(defn cachelpush [k & vals]
  (wcar (apply car/lpush k vals)))

(defn cacherpop [k]
  (wcar (car/rpop k)))

;; ============================================================================
;; UTILITIES: Hashing, AWS SigV4, Date formatting
;; ============================================================================

(defn sha256hex [^String s]
  (let [digest (MessageDigest/getInstance "SHA256")
        bytes  (.digest digest (.getBytes s StandardCharsets/UTF_8))]
    (apply str (map (format "%02x" %) bytes))))

(defn hmacsha256 [^bytes key ^String data]
  (let [mac (Mac/getInstance "HmacSHA256")]
    (.init mac (SecretKeySpec. key "HmacSHA256"))
    (.doFinal mac (.getBytes data StandardCharsets/UTF_8))))

(defn nowiso8601 []
  (.format (DateTimeFormatter/ofPattern "yyyyMMdd'T'HHmmss'Z'")
           (Instant/now)))

(defn datestamp []
  (.format (DateTimeFormatter/ofPattern "yyyyMMdd")
           (Instant/now)))

(defn buildcanonicalrequest [method uri querystring headers payloadhash]
  (let [sortedheaders (sortby first headers)
        canonicalheaders (str/join "\n" (map (fn [[k v]] (str k ":" v)) sortedheaders))
        signedheaders (str/join ";" (map first sortedheaders))]
    (str/join "\n" [method uri querystring canonicalheaders "" signedheaders payloadhash])))

(defn buildstringtosign [algorithm requestdatetime credentialscope canonicalrequesthash]
  (str/join "\n" [algorithm requestdatetime credentialscope canonicalrequesthash]))

(defn derivesigningkey [secretkey datestamp region service]
  (> (.getBytes (str "AWS4" secretkey) StandardCharsets/UTF_8)
      (hmacsha256 datestamp)
      (hmacsha256 region)
      (hmacsha256 service)
      (hmacsha256 "aws4_request")))

(defn signrequest
  "Full AWS Signature Version 4 signing for Bedrock runtime API."
  [{:keys [method host path payload accesskey secretkey region service]}]
  (let [payloadhash    (sha256hex payload)
        amzdate        (nowiso8601)
        datestampval   (datestamp)
        canonicaluri   path
        querystring    ""
        headers         [["host" host]
                         ["xamzdate" amzdate]]
        canonicalreq   (buildcanonicalrequest method canonicaluri querystring headers payloadhash)
        canonicalhash  (sha256hex canonicalreq)
        credentialscope (str datestampval "/" region "/" service "/aws4_request")
        algorithm       "AWS4HMACSHA256"
        stringtosign  (buildstringtosign algorithm amzdate credentialscope canonicalhash)
        signingkey     (derivesigningkey secretkey datestampval region service)
        signature       (apply str (map (format "%02x" %) (hmacsha256 signingkey stringtosign)))
        signedheaders  "host;xamzdate"
        authheader     (str algorithm " "
                             "Credential=" accesskey "/" credentialscope ", "
                             "SignedHeaders=" signedheaders ", "
                             "Signature=" signature)]
    {:headers {"Host" host
               "XAmzDate" amzdate
               "Authorization" authheader
               "ContentType" "application/json"}
     :payloadhash payloadhash}))

;; ============================================================================
;; EXA API CLIENT (search + contents)
;; ============================================================================

(def ^:private exasearchendpoint "")
(def ^:private exacontentsendpoint "")

(defn exasearch
  "Searches Exa. Max 25 results per call. Returns {:results [...]}."
  [{:keys [query numresults type includedomains excludedomains startpublisheddate]}]
  (let [payload (cond> {:query query
                         :num_results (min (or numresults 10) 25)
                         :type (or type "auto")}
                  includedomains (assoc :include_domains includedomains)
                  excludedomains (assoc :exclude_domains excludedomains)
                  startpublisheddate (assoc :start_published_date startpublisheddate))
        cachekey (str "exa:search:" (hash payload))
        cached (cacheget cachekey)]
    (if cached
      (json/parsestring cached true)
      (let [resp (http/post exasearchendpoint
                            {:headers {"Authorization" (str "Bearer " (:exaapikey config))
                                       "ContentType" "application/json"}
                             :body (json/generatestring payload)
                             :as :json
                             :throwexceptions false})
            body (:body resp)]
        (if (= 200 (:status resp))
          (do
            (cachesetex cachekey 1800 (json/generatestring body))
            body)
          (do
            (log/error "Exa search failed:" (:status resp) body)
            {:error "Exa search failed" :status (:status resp)}))))))

(defn exagetcontents
  "Fetches full contents from Exa by IDs. Max 100 IDs per call."
  [ids]
  (let [idslist (take 100 ids)
        payload {:ids idslist :text true :highlights true}
        cachekey (str "exa:contents:" (hash idslist))
        cached (cacheget cachekey)]
    (if cached
      (json/parsestring cached true)
      (let [resp (http/post exacontentsendpoint
                            {:headers {"Authorization" (str "Bearer " (:exaapikey config))
                                       "ContentType" "application/json"}
                             :body (json/generatestring payload)
                             :as :json
                             :throwexceptions false})
            body (:body resp)]
        (if (= 200 (:status resp))
          (do
            (cachesetex cachekey 3600 (json/generatestring body))
            body)
          (do
            (log/error "Exa contents failed:" (:status resp) body)
            {:error "Exa contents failed" :status (:status resp)}))))))

;; ============================================================================
;; BEDROCK CLAUDE SONNET 4.5 CLIENT (real SigV4)
;; ============================================================================

(def ^:private bedrockmodelid "anthropic.claude35sonnet20250228v2:0") ;; Sonnet 4.5 ID per AWS blog

(defn bedrockinvoke
  "Invokes Claude Sonnet 4.5 on Bedrock with full SigV4 signing. Max output: 64K tokens."
  [{:keys [messages maxtokens temperature system]}]
  (let [region    (:awsregion config)
        host      (str "bedrockruntime." region ".amazonaws.com")
        path      (str "/model/" bedrockmodelid "/invoke")
        payloadmap {:messages messages
                     :max_tokens (min (or maxtokens 4096) 65536) ;; hard cap 64K
                     :anthropic_version "bedrock20230531"}
        payloadmap (if temperature (assoc payloadmap :temperature temperature) payloadmap)
        payloadmap (if system (assoc payloadmap :system system) payloadmap)
        payloadstr (json/generatestring payloadmap)
        signed      (signrequest {:method "POST"
                                   :host host
                                   :path path
                                   :payload payloadstr
                                   :accesskey (:awsaccesskey config)
                                   :secretkey (:awssecretkey config)
                                   :region region
                                   :service "bedrock"})
        url         (str "" host path)
        resp        (http/post url
                               {:headers (:headers signed)
                                :body payloadstr
                                :as :json
                                :throwexceptions false})]
    (if (= 200 (:status resp))
      (getin resp [:body :content 0 :text])
      (do
        (log/error "Bedrock invoke failed:" (:status resp) (:body resp))
        {:error "Bedrock invoke failed" :status (:status resp) :body (:body resp)}))))

;; ============================================================================
;; GROK 4 FAST CLIENT (xAI direct or OpenRouter)
;; ============================================================================

(def ^:private grokendpoint "") ;; xAI native endpoint

(defn grokfastinvoke
  "Calls Grok 4 Fast. Context 256K, max output 256K tokens. Pricing: $0.20–0.40 in, $0.50–1.00 out per 1M."
  [{:keys [messages maxtokens temperature]}]
  (let [payload {:model "grok4fast"
                 :messages messages
                 :max_tokens (min (or maxtokens 2048) 256000) ;; practical cap for now
                 :temperature (or temperature 0.7)}
        resp (http/post grokendpoint
                        {:headers {"Authorization" (str "Bearer " (:xaiapikey config))
                                   "ContentType" "application/json"}
                         :body (json/generatestring payload)
                         :as :json
                         :throwexceptions false})]
    (if (= 200 (:status resp))
      (getin resp [:body :choices 0 :message :content])
      (do
        (log/error "Grok 4 Fast invoke failed:" (:status resp) (:body resp))
        {:error "Grok invoke failed" :status (:status resp)}))))

;; ============================================================================
;; CEREBRAS GPTOSS120B CLIENT (OpenAIcompatible)
;; ============================================================================

(def ^:private cerebrasendpoint "")

(defn cerebrasoss120binvoke
  "Calls Cerebras GPTOSS120B. Context 64K (free) / 131K (paid). ~3000 tok/sec throughput."
  [{:keys [messages maxtokens temperature]}]
  (let [payload {:model "gptoss120b"
                 :messages messages
                 :max_tokens (min (or maxtokens 2048) 8192) ;; practical safe cap
                 :temperature (or temperature 0.7)}
        resp (http/post cerebrasendpoint
                        {:headers {"Authorization" (str "Bearer " (:cerebrasapikey config))
                                   "ContentType" "application/json"}
                         :body (json/generatestring payload)
                         :as :json
                         :throwexceptions false})]
    (if (= 200 (:status resp))
      (getin resp [:body :choices 0 :message :content])
      (do
        (log/error "Cerebras invoke failed:" (:status resp) (:body resp))
        {:error "Cerebras invoke failed" :status (:status resp)}))))

;; ============================================================================
;; ORCHESTRATION LOGIC: 90minute autonomous research run
;; ============================================================================

(defn generateoutline
  "Phase 1: Generate research plan with Claude Sonnet 4.5."
  [topic runid]
  (log/info "Generating outline for topic:" topic)
  (let [systemprompt "You are an expert research planner. Create a detailed 20–30 page report outline with section titles, key questions, and citation placeholders."
        userprompt (str "Topic: " topic "\n\nGenerate a comprehensive research outline covering introduction, methodology, key findings sections, case studies, limitations, and references. List 5–10 specific research questions to investigate.")
        outlinetext (bedrockinvoke {:messages [{:role "user" :content userprompt}]
                                      :system systemprompt
                                      :maxtokens 3000
                                      :temperature 0.3})]
    (cachehset (str "run:" runid) "outline" outlinetext)
    (log/info "Outline generated and cached.")
    outlinetext))

(defn extractresearchquestions
  "Extract bulletlist questions from outline text (simple heuristic)."
  [outlinetext]
  (>> (str/splitlines outlinetext)
       (filter (or (str/startswith? % " ") (str/startswith? % " ") (str/startswith? % "? ")))
       (map (str/replace % "^[\\?]\s" ""))
       (take 10)))

(defn searchandgather
  "Phase 2: Multiquery Exa search + content extraction. Stores results in Dragonfly."
  [questions runid]
  (log/info "Starting search phase for" (count questions) "questions.")
  (doseq [q questions]
    (let [searchres (exasearch {:query q :numresults 10 :type "neural"})
          resultids (mapv :id (:results searchres))]
      (when (seq resultids)
        (cachesadd (str "run:" runid ":searchids") resultids)
        (log/info "Gathered" (count resultids) "results for question:" q))))
  (let [allids (cachesmembers (str "run:" runid ":searchids"))
        uniqueids (distinct allids)
        contentsresult (exagetcontents uniqueids)]
    (cachehset (str "run:" runid) "contentsraw" (json/generatestring contentsresult))
    (log/info "Fetched contents for" (count uniqueids) "unique IDs.")
    contentsresult))

(defn triagesources
  "Phase 3: Use Grok 4 Fast to quickly score and filter sources."
  [contentsdata runid]
  (log/info "Triaging sources with Grok 4 Fast...")
  (let [summaries (map (fn [c] {:id (:id c) :title (:title c) :snippet (subs (:text c "") 0 (min 300 (count (:text c ""))))})
                       (:results contentsdata))
        prompt (str "You are a research triage assistant. Below are source snippets. Rate each from 1–10 for relevance and reliability. Return JSON array: [{\"id\":\"...\", \"score\":8}, ...].\n\nSources:\n"
                    (json/generatestring summaries))
        triagejson (grokfastinvoke {:messages [{:role "user" :content prompt}] :maxtokens 1500})
        scores (try (json/parsestring triagejson true) (catch Exception _ []))]
    (cachehset (str "run:" runid) "triagescores" (json/generatestring scores))
    (log/info "Triage completed. Scores cached.")
    scores))

(defn synthesizesections
  "Phase 4: Use Cerebras 120B for fast draft generation, then Sonnet for polish."
  [contentsdata outline runid]
  (log/info "Synthesizing report sections...")
  (let [sections (str/split outline "\n") ;; naive split by markdown headers
        draftparts (atom [])]
    (doseq [section sections]
      (when (> (count section) 10)
        (let [notes (str "Outline section:\n" section "\n\nAvailable research data:\n"
                         (json/generatestring (take 5 (:results contentsdata))))
              draft (cerebrasoss120binvoke {:messages [{:role "user" :content (str "Write a detailed, citationready paragraph for this section:\n" notes)}]
                                              :maxtokens 1500
                                              :temperature 0.5})]
          (swap! draftparts conj draft)
          (log/info "Section draft generated via Cerebras."))))
    (let [combineddraft (str/join "\n\n" @draftparts)]
      (cachehset (str "run:" runid) "draft" combineddraft)
      (log/info "All section drafts combined and cached.")
      combineddraft)))

(defn finalpolish
  "Phase 5: Final QA and polish with Claude Sonnet 4.5."
  [draft outline runid]
  (log/info "Final polish with Claude Sonnet 4.5...")
  (let [systemprompt "You are a senior research editor. Polish this draft into a professional, citationready 20–30 page report. Ensure coherence, proper citations, and executive summary."
        userprompt (str "Original outline:\n" outline "\n\nDraft report:\n" draft "\n\nProduce final polished report with title, abstract, sections, and references.")
        finalreport (bedrockinvoke {:messages [{:role "user" :content userprompt}]
                                      :system systemprompt
                                      :maxtokens 16000
                                      :temperature 0.2})]
    (cachehset (str "run:" runid) "finalreport" finalreport)
    (log/info "Final report complete and cached.")
    finalreport))

(defn autonomousresearchpipeline
  "Full 90minute autonomous pipeline. Returns runid."
  [topic]
  (let [runid (str "run" (System/currentTimeMillis))]
    (future
      (try
        (log/info "Starting autonomous research pipeline for run:" runid)
        (cachehset (str "run:" runid) "status" "running")
        (cachehset (str "run:" runid) "topic" topic)

        ;; Phase 1: Outline (0–5 min)
        (let [outline (generateoutline topic runid)
              questions (extractresearchquestions outline)]

          ;; Phase 2: Search + gather (5–50 min)
          (let [contents (searchandgather questions runid)]

            ;; Phase 3: Triage (50–60 min)
            (triagesources contents runid)

            ;; Phase 4: Synthesis (60–80 min)
            (let [draft (synthesizesections contents outline runid)]

              ;; Phase 5: Final polish (80–90 min)
              (finalpolish draft outline runid))))

        (cachehset (str "run:" runid) "status" "completed")
        (log/info "Pipeline completed for run:" runid)
        (catch Exception e
          (log/error e "Pipeline failed for run:" runid)
          (cachehset (str "run:" runid) "status" "failed")
          (cachehset (str "run:" runid) "error" (.getMessage e)))))
    runid))

;; ============================================================================
;; HTTP API ROUTES
;; ============================================================================

(defroutes approutes
  (GET "/health" []
       (resp/response {:status "ok"}))

  (POST "/api/start" {body :body}
        (let [topic (get body "topic")]
          (if (str/blank? topic)
            (> (resp/response {:error "Missing topic"})
                (resp/status 400))
            (let [runid (autonomousresearchpipeline topic)]
              (resp/response {:run_id runid :status "started"})))))

  (GET "/api/status/:runid" [runid]
       (let [data (cachehgetall (str "run:" runid))]
         (if (empty? data)
           (> (resp/response {:error "Run not found"})
               (resp/status 404))
           (resp/response (into {} (map (fn [[k v]] [(keyword k) v]) (partition 2 data)))))))

  (GET "/api/report/:runid" [runid]
       (let [report (cacheget (str "run:" runid ":finalreport"))]
         (if report
           (resp/response {:report report})
           (> (resp/response {:error "Report not ready or not found"})
               (resp/status 404)))))

  (POST "/api/search" {body :body}
        (let [query (get body "query")
              num (get body "num_results" 10)]
          (resp/response (exasearch {:query query :numresults num}))))

  (POST "/api/contents" {body :body}
        (let [ids (get body "ids")]
          (resp/response (exagetcontents ids))))

  (POST "/api/bedrock" {body :body}
        (let [messages (get body "messages")
              maxtok (get body "max_tokens" 2000)]
          (resp/response {:text (bedrockinvoke {:messages messages :maxtokens maxtok})})))

  (POST "/api/grok" {body :body}
        (let [messages (get body "messages")
              maxtok (get body "max_tokens" 1500)]
          (resp/response {:text (grokfastinvoke {:messages messages :maxtokens maxtok})})))

  (POST "/api/cerebras" {body :body}
        (let [messages (get body "messages")
              maxtok (get body "max_tokens" 1500)]
          (resp/response {:text (cerebrasoss120binvoke {:messages messages :maxtokens maxtok})})))

  (route/notfound {:error "Not found"}))

(def app
  (> approutes
      (wrapjsonbody {:keywords? true})
      wrapjsonresponse
      wrapparams
      (wrapcors :accesscontrolalloworigin ["."]
                 :accesscontrolallowmethods [:get :post :options]
                 :accesscontrolallowheaders ["contenttype" "authorization"])))

(defn main [& args]
  (validateconfig!)
  (log/info "Starting autonomous research agent server on port" (:port config))
  (runjetty app {:port (:port config) :join? false}))

        stringtosign  (buildstringtosign algorithm amzdate credentialscope canonicalhash)
        signingkey     (derivesigningkey secretkey datestampval region service)
        signature       (apply str (map (format "%02x" %) (hmacsha256 signingkey stringtosign)))
        signedheaders  "host;xamzdate"
        authheader     (str algorithm " "
                             "Credential=" accesskey "/" credentialscope ", "
                             "SignedHeaders=" signedheaders ", "
                             "Signature=" signature)]
    {:headers {"Host" host
               "XAmzDate" amzdate
               "Authorization" authheader
               "ContentType" "application/json"}
     :payloadhash payloadhash}))

;; ============================================================================
;; EXA API CLIENT (search + contents)
;; ============================================================================

(def ^:private exasearchendpoint "")
(def ^:private exacontentsendpoint "")

(defn exasearch
  "Searches Exa. Max 25 results per call. Returns {:results [...]}."
  [{:keys [query numresults type includedomains excludedomains startpublisheddate]}]
  (let [payload (cond> {:query query
                         :num_results (min (or numresults 10) 25)
                         :type (or type "auto")}
                  includedomains (assoc :include_domains includedomains)
                  excludedomains (assoc :exclude_domains excludedomains)
                  startpublisheddate (assoc :start_published_date startpublisheddate))
        cachekey (str "exa:search:" (hash payload))
        cached (cacheget cachekey)]
    (if cached
      (json/parsestring cached true)
      (let [resp (http/post exasearchendpoint
                            {:headers {"Authorization" (str "Bearer " (:exaapikey config))
                                       "ContentType" "application/json"}
                             :body (json/generatestring payload)
                             :as :json
                             :throwexceptions false})
            body (:body resp)]
        (if (= 200 (:status resp))
          (do
            (cachesetex cachekey 1800 (json/generatestring body))
            body)
          (do
            (log/error "Exa search failed:" (:status resp) body)
            {:error "Exa search failed" :status (:status resp)}))))))

(defn exagetcontents
  "Fetches full contents from Exa by IDs. Max 100 IDs per call."
  [ids]
  (let [idslist (take 100 ids)
        payload {:ids idslist :text true :highlights true}
        cachekey (str "exa:contents:" (hash idslist))
        cached (cacheget cachekey)]
    (if cached
      (json/parsestring cached true)
      (let [resp (http/post exacontentsendpoint
                            {:headers {"Authorization" (str "Bearer " (:exaapikey config))
                                       "ContentType" "application/json"}
                             :body (json/generatestring payload)
                             :as :json
                             :throwexceptions false})
            body (:body resp)]
        (if (= 200 (:status resp))
          (do
            (cachesetex cachekey 3600 (json/generatestring body))
            body)
          (do
            (log/error "Exa contents failed:" (:status resp) body)
            {:error "Exa contents failed" :status (:status resp)}))))))

;; ============================================================================
;; BEDROCK CLAUDE SONNET 4.5 CLIENT (real SigV4)
;; ============================================================================

(def ^:private bedrockmodelid "anthropic.claude35sonnet20250228v2:0") ;; Sonnet 4.5 ID per AWS blog

(defn bedrockinvoke
  "Invokes Claude Sonnet 4.5 on Bedrock with full SigV4 signing. Max output: 64K tokens."
  [{:keys [messages maxtokens temperature system]}]
  (let [region    (:awsregion config)
        host      (str "bedrockruntime." region ".amazonaws.com")
        path      (str "/model/" bedrockmodelid "/invoke")
        payloadmap {:messages messages
                     :max_tokens (min (or maxtokens 4096) 65536) ;; hard cap 64K
                     :anthropic_version "bedrock20230531"}
        payloadmap (if temperature (assoc payloadmap :temperature temperature) payloadmap)
        payloadmap (if system (assoc payloadmap :system system) payloadmap)
        payloadstr (json/generatestring payloadmap)
        signed      (signrequest {:method "POST"
                                   :host host
                                   :path path
                                   :payload payloadstr
                                   :accesskey (:awsaccesskey config)
                                   :secretkey (:awssecretkey config)
                                   :region region
                                   :service "bedrock"})
        url         (str "" host path)
        resp        (http/post url
                               {:headers (:headers signed)
                                :body payloadstr
                                :as :json
                                :throwexceptions false})]
    (if (= 200 (:status resp))
      (getin resp [:body :content 0 :text])
      (do
        (log/error "Bedrock invoke failed:" (:status resp) (:body resp))
        {:error "Bedrock invoke failed" :status (:status resp) :body (:body resp)}))))

;; ============================================================================
;; GROK 4 FAST CLIENT (xAI direct or OpenRouter)
;; ============================================================================

(def ^:private grokendpoint "") ;; xAI native endpoint

(defn grokfastinvoke
  "Calls Grok 4 Fast. Context 256K, max output 256K tokens. Pricing: $0.20–0.40 in, $0.50–1.00 out per 1M."
  [{:keys [messages maxtokens temperature]}]
  (let [payload {:model "grok4fast"
                 :messages messages
                 :max_tokens (min (or maxtokens 2048) 256000) ;; practical cap for now
                 :temperature (or temperature 0.7)}
        resp (http/post grokendpoint
                        {:headers {"Authorization" (str "Bearer " (:xaiapikey config))
                                   "ContentType" "application/json"}
                         :body (json/generatestring payload)
                         :as :json
                         :throwexceptions false})]
    (if (= 200 (:status resp))
      (getin resp [:body :choices 0 :message :content])
      (do
        (log/error "Grok 4 Fast invoke failed:" (:status resp) (:body resp))
        {:error "Grok invoke failed" :status (:status resp)}))))

;; ============================================================================
;; CEREBRAS GPTOSS120B CLIENT (OpenAIcompatible)
;; ============================================================================

(def ^:private cerebrasendpoint "")

(defn cerebrasoss120binvoke
  "Calls Cerebras GPTOSS120B. Context 64K (free) / 131K (paid). ~3000 tok/sec throughput."
  [{:keys [messages maxtokens temperature]}]
  (let [payload {:model "gptoss120b"
                 :messages messages
                 :max_tokens (min (or maxtokens 2048) 8192) ;; practical safe cap
                 :temperature (or temperature 0.7)}
        resp (http/post cerebrasendpoint
                        {:headers {"Authorization" (str "Bearer " (:cerebrasapikey config))
                                   "ContentType" "application/json"}
                         :body (json/generatestring payload)
                         :as :json
                         :throwexceptions false})]
    (if (= 200 (:status resp))
      (getin resp [:body :choices 0 :message :content])
      (do
        (log/error "Cerebras invoke failed:" (:status resp) (:body resp))
        {:error "Cerebras invoke failed" :status (:status resp)}))))

;; ============================================================================
;; ORCHESTRATION LOGIC: 90minute autonomous research run
;; ============================================================================

(defn generateoutline
  "Phase 1: Generate research plan with Claude Sonnet 4.5."
  [topic runid]
  (log/info "Generating outline for topic:" topic)
  (let [systemprompt "You are an expert research planner. Create a detailed 20–30 page report outline with section titles, key questions, and citation placeholders."
        userprompt (str "Topic: " topic "\n\nGenerate a comprehensive research outline covering introduction, methodology, key findings sections, case studies, limitations, and references. List 5–10 specific research questions to investigate.")
        outlinetext (bedrockinvoke {:messages [{:role "user" :content userprompt}]
                                      :system systemprompt
                                      :maxtokens 3000
                                      :temperature 0.3})]
    (cachehset (str "run:" runid) "outline" outlinetext)
    (log/info "Outline generated and cached.")
    outlinetext))

(defn extractresearchquestions
  "Extract bulletlist questions from outline text (simple heuristic)."
  [outlinetext]
  (>> (str/splitlines outlinetext)
       (filter (or (str/startswith? % " ") (str/startswith? % " ") (str/startswith? % "? ")))
       (map (str/replace % "^[\\?]\s" ""))
       (take 10)))

(defn searchandgather
  "Phase 2: Multiquery Exa search + content extraction. Stores results in Dragonfly."
  [questions runid]
  (log/info "Starting search phase for" (count questions) "questions.")
  (doseq [q questions]
    (let [searchres (exasearch {:query q :numresults 10 :type "neural"})
          resultids (mapv :id (:results searchres))]
      (when (seq resultids)
        (cachesadd (str "run:" runid ":searchids") resultids)
        (log/info "Gathered" (count resultids) "results for question:" q))))
  (let [allids (cachesmembers (str "run:" runid ":searchids"))
        uniqueids (distinct allids)
        contentsresult (exagetcontents uniqueids)]
    (cachehset (str "run:" runid) "contentsraw" (json/generatestring contentsresult))
    (log/info "Fetched contents for" (count uniqueids) "unique IDs.")
    contentsresult))

(defn triagesources
  "Phase 3: Use Grok 4 Fast to quickly score and filter sources."
  [contentsdata runid]
  (log/info "Triaging sources with Grok 4 Fast...")
  (let [summaries (map (fn [c] {:id (:id c) :title (:title c) :snippet (subs (:text c "") 0 (min 300 (count (:text c ""))))})
                       (:results contentsdata))
        prompt (str "You are a research triage assistant. Below are source snippets. Rate each from 1–10 for relevance and reliability. Return JSON array: [{\"id\":\"...\", \"score\":8}, ...].\n\nSources:\n"
                    (json/generatestring summaries))
        triagejson (grokfastinvoke {:messages [{:role "user" :content prompt}] :maxtokens 1500})
        scores (try (json/parsestring triagejson true) (catch Exception _ []))]
    (cachehset (str "run:" runid) "triagescores" (json/generatestring scores))
    (log/info "Triage completed. Scores cached.")
    scores))

(defn synthesizesections
  "Phase 4: Use Cerebras 120B for fast draft generation, then Sonnet for polish."
  [contentsdata outline runid]
  (log/info "Synthesizing report sections...")
  (let [sections (str/split outline "\n") ;; naive split by markdown headers
        draftparts (atom [])]
    (doseq [section sections]
      (when (> (count section) 10)
        (let [notes (str "Outline section:\n" section "\n\nAvailable research data:\n"
                         (json/generatestring (take 5 (:results contentsdata))))
              draft (cerebrasoss120binvoke {:messages [{:role "user" :content (str "Write a detailed, citationready paragraph for this section:\n" notes)}]
                                              :maxtokens 1500
                                              :temperature 0.5})]
          (swap! draftparts conj draft)
          (log/info "Section draft generated via Cerebras."))))
    (let [combineddraft (str/join "\n\n" @draftparts)]
      (cachehset (str "run:" runid) "draft" combineddraft)
      (log/info "All section drafts combined and cached.")
      combineddraft)))

(defn finalpolish
  "Phase 5: Final QA and polish with Claude Sonnet 4.5."
  [draft outline runid]
  (log/info "Final polish with Claude Sonnet 4.5...")
  (let [systemprompt "You are a senior research editor. Polish this draft into a professional, citationready 20–30 page report. Ensure coherence, proper citations, and executive summary."
        userprompt (str "Original outline:\n" outline "\n\nDraft report:\n" draft "\n\nProduce final polished report with title, abstract, sections, and references.")
        finalreport (bedrockinvoke {:messages [{:role "user" :content userprompt}]
                                      :system systemprompt
                                      :maxtokens 16000
                                      :temperature 0.2})]
    (cachehset (str "run:" runid) "finalreport" finalreport)
    (log/info "Final report complete and cached.")
    finalreport))

(defn autonomousresearchpipeline
  "Full 90minute autonomous pipeline. Returns runid."
  [topic]
  (let [runid (str "run" (System/currentTimeMillis))]
    (future
      (try
        (log/info "Starting autonomous research pipeline for run:" runid)
        (cachehset (str "run:" runid) "status" "running")
        (cachehset (str "run:" runid) "topic" topic)

        ;; Phase 1: Outline (0–5 min)
        (let [outline (generateoutline topic runid)
              questions (extractresearchquestions outline)]

          ;; Phase 2: Search + gather (5–50 min)
          (let [contents (searchandgather questions runid)]

            ;; Phase 3: Triage (50–60 min)
            (triagesources contents runid)

            ;; Phase 4: Synthesis (60–80 min)
            (let [draft (synthesizesections contents outline runid)]

              ;; Phase 5: Final polish (80–90 min)
              (finalpolish draft outline runid))))

        (cachehset (str "run:" runid) "status" "completed")
        (log/info "Pipeline completed for run:" runid)
        (catch Exception e
          (log/error e "Pipeline failed for run:" runid)
          (cachehset (str "run:" runid) "status" "failed")
          (cachehset (str "run:" runid) "error" (.getMessage e)))))
    runid))

;; ============================================================================
;; HTTP API ROUTES
;; ============================================================================

(defroutes approutes
  (GET "/health" []
       (resp/response {:status "ok"}))

  (POST "/api/start" {body :body}
        (let [topic (get body "topic")]
          (if (str/blank? topic)
            (> (resp/response {:error "Missing topic"})
                (resp/status 400))
            (let [runid (autonomousresearchpipeline topic)]
              (resp/response {:run_id runid :status "started"})))))

  (GET "/api/status/:runid" [runid]
       (let [data (cachehgetall (str "run:" runid))]
         (if (empty? data)
           (> (resp/response {:error "Run not found"})
               (resp/status 404))
           (resp/response (into {} (map (fn [[k v]] [(keyword k) v]) (partition 2 data)))))))

  (GET "/api/report/:runid" [runid]
       (let [report (cacheget (str "run:" runid ":finalreport"))]
         (if report
           (resp/response {:report report})
           (> (resp/response {:error "Report not ready or not found"})
               (resp/status 404)))))

  (POST "/api/search" {body :body}
        (let [query (get body "query")
              num (get body "num_results" 10)]
          (resp/response (exasearch {:query query :numresults num}))))

  (POST "/api/contents" {body :body}
        (let [ids (get body "ids")]
          (resp/response (exagetcontents ids))))

  (POST "/api/bedrock" {body :body}
        (let [messages (get body "messages")
              maxtok (get body "max_tokens" 2000)]
          (resp/response {:text (bedrockinvoke {:messages messages :maxtokens maxtok})})))

  (POST "/api/grok" {body :body}
        (let [messages (get body "messages")
              maxtok (get body "max_tokens" 1500)]
          (resp/response {:text (grokfastinvoke {:messages messages :maxtokens maxtok})})))

  (POST "/api/cerebras" {body :body}
        (let [messages (get body "messages")
              maxtok (get body "max_tokens" 1500)]
          (resp/response {:text (cerebrasoss120binvoke {:messages messages :maxtokens maxtok})})))

  (route/notfound {:error "Not found"}))

(def app
  (> approutes
      (wrapjsonbody {:keywords? true})
      wrapjsonresponse
      wrapparams
      (wrapcors :accesscontrolalloworigin ["."]
                 :accesscontrolallowmethods [:get :post :options]
                 :accesscontrolallowheaders ["contenttype" "authorization"])))

(defn main [& args]
  (validateconfig!)
  (log/info "Starting autonomous research agent server on port" (:port config))
  (runjetty app {:port (:port config) :join? false}))

Ez egy Clojureban írt HTTP szerver és autonóm kutatási ügynök backend, amely a Ring/Jetty ökoszisztémára épül Compojure alapú útvonalkezeléssel és JSON middlewarerel. Külső AIszolgáltatásokat integrál (Exa webkeresés, Amazon Bedrock/Claude, xAI Grok 4 Fast, Cerebras gptoss120B) és Dragonfly/Redis kompatibilis gyorsítótárat használ a teljesítmény és robusztusság érdekében.[1][2][3][4][5][6][7][8][9]

 Szerver és routing
A kiszolgáló a Ring HTTP absztrakcióját használja, amely a Clojure webalkalmazások de facto szabványa a handler–middleware modellre építve. A futtatást a beépített Jetty adapter végzi, amely a runjetty hívással indít egy beágyazott Jetty webszervert. Az útvonalak Compojure DSLlel vannak definiálva, ami tömör módszer HTTP végpontok leírására Ring fölött.[2][10][4][1]

 JSON kezelés
A válaszok és kérések JSONra/JSONból alakítását a Ring JSON middleware biztosítja, amely a wrapjsonbody és wrapjsonresponse rétegekkel működik. A tényleges JSON kódoláshoz gyakori választás a Cheshire könyvtár, amely gyors JSON encode/decode funkciókat kínál Clojurehoz. A middleware célja, hogy a routehandlerek Clojure mapokkal dolgozzanak, a JSON transzformációt átláthatóan kezelve.[11][12][13][9][14]

 Gyorsítótárazás és állapot
A rendszer Dragonflyt használ Redis/Memcached APIkompatibilis inmemory adatbázisként, így Redisparancsokkal (GET, SETEX, HGETALL, SMEMBERS stb.) kezelhető cacheként. A Dragonfly célja, hogy zökkenőmentes migrációt és jelentős teljesítménynyereséget biztosítson Rediskompatibilis módon. A protokollkompatibilitás lehetővé teszi a meglévő Rediskliensek használatát minimális vagy nulla kódmódosítással.[3][15][16]

 Exa webkeresés integráció
Az Exa API a weben végez intelligens keresést, és a találatokból strukturált tartalom kinyerését is támogatja egy dedikált search végponton. Az Exa platform célja a valós idejű AIalapú keresés és tartalomextrakció LLMek számára optimalizálva. Az ökoszisztémában általános a “search + contents” minta, ahol előbb keresés történik, majd a kiválasztott találatok teljes szövege kerül lekérésre.[5][17][18]

 Bedrock/Claude hívások és SigV4
Az Amazon Bedrock modellhívások az InvokeModel művelettel történnek a /model/{modelId}/invoke végponton, amely a kérést és a paramétereket a törzsben várja. Ezek a kérések AWS Signature Version 4 aláírást igényelnek, ami a törzs hashét, dátumot, régiót és szolgáltatást figyelembe vevő aláírási folyamat. A Bedrock egységes módot kínál különböző foundation modellek meghívására, beleértve az Anthropic Claude család tagjait is.[19][6][20]

 xAI Grok 4 Fast triage
A Grok 4 Fast az xAI költséghatékony, nagy kontextusú, webböngészésre és eszközhasználatra tanított modellje, amely APIn keresztül érhető el. Nyilvános aggregátorok és bejelentések a 2M tokenes kontextusablakot és magas költséghatékonyságot emelik ki különböző használati módokkal. Független hazai beszámolók is a böngészési/ügynöki képességeket és elérhetőséget hangsúlyozzák.[21][22][23][7]

 Cerebras GPTOSS120B vázlatírás
A Cerebras Inference Chat Completions API OpenAIkompatibilis mintával hívható, és támogatja a gptoss120b modellt. A Cerebras dokumentáció külön kiemeli, hogy a “gptoss120b” a chat completions végponton elérhető modellazonosító. Közösségi és integrációs útmutatók a nagy áteresztőképességű inferenciát és gyors válaszidőt hangsúlyozzák ezzel a modellel.[8][24][25]

 Kutatási pipeline logika
A kód által megvalósított pipeline tipikusan: outline generálás (Claude/Bedrock), kérdéslista kivonat, Exa keresés és tartalomgyűjtés, források triage (Grok 4 Fast), gyors vázlat (Cerebras), majd végső csiszolás (Claude/Bedrock). Az ilyen többmodelleszközlánc célja, hogy a webes forrásokból vett naprakész információt strukturált jelentéssé szintetizálja. A komponensek mind APIn keresztül hívhatók, így automatizált, hosszabb kutatási futtatások is megvalósíthatók.[17][6][5][8]

 Mikor hasznos
Olyan riportkészítő és információkinyerő feladatoknál hasznos, ahol a webes keresés, tartalomösszegyűjtés és LLMalapú szintézis kombinációja értéket ad. A valós idejű, naprakész adatokhoz Exa biztosít hozzáférést, míg a szerkesztett outputot a nagy nyelvi modellek adják Bedrockon és más inference szolgáltatókon. Nagy volumenű vagy hosszú dokumentumok feldolgozásakor a Grok 4 Fast nagy kontextusa és a Cerebras nagy áteresztése különösen előnyös lehet.[6][7][5][17][8]

 Biztonsági és üzemeltetési jegyzetek
Bedrock hívásoknál mindig szükséges a helyes SigV4 aláírás, ami a kérés törzsétől és időbélyegétől is függ, ezért dinamikusan kell előállítani. A modellhívás szintaxisa és az engedélyezés az AWS dokumentáció szerint történik, a “bedrock:InvokeModel” jogosultsági művelettel. A Jettys Ring szerver beágyazott módon futtatható, ami egyszerűsíti a telepítést és a hordozhatóságot.[2][19][6]
